primaryQuery: towing a caravan nz / towing regulations nz
accuracyFlags: FAQ: 'A full car licence covers most combinations up to 4,500 kg of combined weight. Above that you need a heavier class.' - wrong: NZTA says 4,500 kg combined is the limit for learner/restricted licences; a full class 1 licence allows combined weight up to 6,000 kg (and trailers over 3,500 GLW need a further endorsement). Fix.
FAQ: '90 km/h ... applies whatever the sign says' - wrong direction: 90 km/h is a maximum; a lower signed limit still applies.
Body: 'The maximum open-road speed while towing is 90 km/h with a rigid connection' - rigid-connection qualifier is correct but unexplained; non-rigid connection max is 50 km/h on any road.

Section 07 lists Crown Range and Rimutaka Hill Road as 'prohibited or strongly discouraged for large combinations' - neither is prohibited for ordinary caravans; Rimutaka closes to high-sided vehicles in wind only. Reword and cite NZTA.
'Light trailers and caravans are limited to 90 km/h' and 'ten percent tow ball weight' - unsourced beyond NZTA general page; add specific NZTA light-trailer and towing page links, dated 2026.
Page says tow capacity 'is a legal limit' - correct only for vehicle/towbar plate limits; clarify.
